dialogues.speaker: Padisarah
dialogues.text: Fairy Nilou, can you teach Padisarah how to dance?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Oh, of course! How about we start off with the most basic steps?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: What about you, Grandpa Almond? Would you like to join?

dialogues.speaker: Almond
dialogues.text: This old nutcracker? Hah, I'm not quite as limber as I used to be...

dialogues.speaker: Almond
dialogues.text: Alright, alright... Grandpa can't say no to you, can he...
